evidence: Graesse, Orbis Latinus s.v. Monoecum: Monoecum, s. Herculis Monoeci prt.
terms.comment: The ancient name, the stronghold of Monoecus (a surname of Hercules); also portus Herculis Monoecī (Plin. 3.47, Lewis & Short).
A town: Monacum (to), Monacī (in), Monacō (from). Beware: in Graesse Monacum is Munich (s.v. Monacum), and Monaco is Herculis Monoecī portus (s.v. Monoecum).

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio, geographical section, with the authorities it cites (cited as M-O s.v.).

J. G. Th. Graesse, Orbis Latinus, edition of F. Benedict (1909), Latin–German, read in the digitization at columbia.edu (cited as Graesse, Orbis Latinus s.v.); its forms are post-classical unless Lewis & Short has them.
